test.result: 118 passed; Ruff and mypy passed for the custody module.

implemented: ManifestJournal can persist canonical manifests and session outcomes in the hash-chained DurableJournal and reconstruct them after restart.
Persisted manifests are revalidated against their canonical digest and decision/record/entry clock order during recovery.
Outcome vocabulary includes SUBMITTED, NO_SIGNAL, NO_TRADE, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ORDER and unsuccessful/abstained states; scheduled denominator reports missing rows as UNRECORDED.
The forward session runner separately persists decisions, risk results, outbox uncertainty, execution receipts and terminal outcomes.
blockers: ManifestJournal persistence is not yet wired into ForwardSessionRunner as the one authoritative session stream.
Session-date planning and manifest/outcome journaling are separate append-only logs, so there is no atomic cross-ledger completeness transaction yet.
